Struct KrillaGlyph 

Source 
pub struct KrillaGlyph {
    pub glyph_id: GlyphId,
    pub text_range: Range<usize>,
    pub x_advance: f32,
    pub x_offset: f32,
    pub y_offset: f32,
    pub y_advance: f32,
    pub location: Option<Location>,
}
Expand description

A glyph type that implements Glyph.

You can use it if you don’t have your own type of glyph that you want to use.

Fields§

§glyph_id: GlyphId

The glyph ID of the glyph.

§text_range: Range<usize>

The range in the original text that corresponds to the cluster of the glyph.

§x_advance: f32

The advance of the glyph.

§x_offset: f32

The x offset of the glyph.

§y_offset: f32

The y offset of the glyph.

§y_advance: f32

The y advance of the glyph.

§location: Option<Location>

The location of the glyph.

impl KrillaGlyph

Source

pub fn new( glyph_id: GlyphId, x_advance: f32, x_offset: f32, y_offset: f32, y_advance: f32, range: Range<usize>, location: Option<Location>, ) -> Self

Create a new krilla glyph.

Important: x_advance, x_offset, y_offset and y_advance need to be normalized, i.e. divided by the units per em!
